title: Sideways tables are marked for manual review
summary: Pages dominated by sideways or upside-down PDF text now require manual table review instead of showing a misleading completed extraction.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

When a table page contains mostly sideways or upside-down PDF text that the table reader cannot reliably interpret, extraction reports an unsupported structure. It does not present a fragment of the table as a completed result.

## Why it matters

A recognized header alone can omit the transactions underneath it. These pages now clearly require review of the original.

## Where to find it

Use **Extract Tables** in the PDF toolbox. Pages already displayed upright by their PDF rotation settings continue to use normal table extraction.
